nodes.name: Edge Delivery & Hydration Strategy
nodes.subtitle: Developer Implementation Pattern
nodes.description: storeleads.app renders with fast edge-cached responses, keeping TTFB around 988ms. Architecture: Deploy on edge CDN nodes (e.g. Cloudflare / Vercel Edge). Cache static assets with immutable cache-control, revalidate dynamic data with SWR or React Query.

nodes.name: Design System & Token Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Developer Implementation Pattern
nodes.description: Consistent typography, high-contrast dark theme surfaces, and smooth micro-animations across all interactive surfaces. Architecture: Establish semantic color tokens (--color-background, --color-accent, --color-border) with HSL or P3 color spaces. Keep layouts responsive with clamp() and fluid flexbox/grid.

nodes.name: Clone Recipe: Global Search / Query Bar
nodes.subtitle: Developer Implementation Pattern
nodes.description: Developers looking to replicate Global Search / Query Bar from storeleads.app can follow this proven pattern. Architecture: Build with Radix Popover or cmdk library. Use debounced inputs (useDebounce 250ms), prefetch results or index with Fuse.js for instant client-side matching.
